definitions.latest: the most recent unflagged primary report
definitions.vs_previous_7_days: latest price vs the average of reports dated in the 7 days before it
definitions.vs_previous_30_days: latest price vs the average of reports dated in the 30 days before it
definitions.range_52_weeks: lowest and highest report in the 364 days up to the latest report, and where the latest lies
definitions.volatility_91_days_pct: standard deviation of log changes between consecutive reports in the 91 days up to the latest report (needs at least 3 changes)

note: Descriptive statistics of past reports, not a forecast.

source.provider: Directorate of Marketing and Inspection, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
